question: A boat travels downstream at a speed of 25 km/hr and upstream at a speed of 15 km/hr. What is the speed of the stream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of the stream = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

Speed of the stream = (25 − 15) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of the stream = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/hr.**
